record.paper_title: On some open problems in Diophantine approximation
record.original_question: Let p be a prime. For an integer n = p^nu n_1 with gcd(n_1,p)=1, define the p-adic norm by |n|_p = p^(-nu). For every real number theta, must lim inf as q tends to infinity of q |q|_p ||q theta|| equal 0? Equivalently, for every irrational theta, must inf over positive integers n and q of q ||p^n q theta|| equal 0?

evidence.quote: Let for a prime p consider the p-adic norm | · |p, that is if n = pν n1 , (n1 , p) = 1, ν ∈ Z+ then |n|p = p−ν .
De Mathan and Teulié conjectured [93] that for any θ ∈ R one has lim inf q|q|p ||qθ|| = 0.
The conjecture can be reformulated as follows: to prove or to disprove that for irrational θ one has inf q||pn qθ|| = 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix a prime number p. For a nonzero integer n, write n = p^ν · n₁ where ν is a nonnegative integer and gcd(n₁, p) = 1, and define the p-adic absolute value by |n|_p = p^(-ν), with |0|_p = 0. For a real number x, let ‖x‖ denote the distance from x to the nearest integer.

Prove or disprove: for every real number θ,
   liminf_{q → ∞, q ∈ ℤ_{>0}} q · |q|_p · ‖qθ‖ = 0.

Equivalently, prove or disprove that for every irrational real number θ,
   inf_{n, q ∈ ℤ_{>0}} q · ‖p^n q θ‖ = 0.
artifact.status_search_result: The original p-adic (mixed) Littlewood conjecture of de Mathan and Teulié remains open as of 2025–2026. Recent activity has focused on the function-field analogue, where counterexamples to the P(t)-adic Littlewood conjecture have been found over certain small finite fields, but these do not resolve the original real-number case.

status_evidence.title: Combinatorics on Number Walls and the P(t)-adic Littlewood Conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work on the function-field analogue of the p-adic Littlewood conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research on analogues; original conjecture not resolved.

status_evidence.title: Counterexamples to the p(t)-adic Littlewood Conjecture Over Small Finite Fields
status_evidence.snippet: Counterexamples are found in the function-field setting over small finite fields.
status_evidence.claim: Function-field analogue fails in some characteristics; original real case remains open.

status_evidence.title: On the t-adic Littlewood Conjecture (Duke Math. J.)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the t-adic analogue, indicating original p-adic Littlewood conjecture is still under investigation.
status_evidence.claim: Original p-adic Littlewood conjecture remains open.
